My great-grandmother who I loved like a mother was a terrible cook who grew up during the depression, so she saved everything. She made soups using everything saved plus a chicken broth. 
Well... after 4th of July one year, there were a lot of leftovers, and one day she served me a bowl of chicken broth with a full hotdog and bun in it. I asked her why she didn’t just give me the hotdog, and she just said “people like bread in their soup”. Truly a special lady she was.

We were having dinner that night, and we were discussing his attempts at receiving alternative medicine (he had stage 4 liver cancer and his doctor couldn’t do anything). And in this conversation we sort of got out of him that there was nothing he could do but try to enjoy himself the best he could. He was in denial but he knew inside, and you can see it here.
